documentation.title: Match Trailing Comma
documentation.standard: For single-line match expressions, there should be no comma after the last arm.

code.title: Valid: No comma after the last arm.
Invalid: Comma after the last arm.

documentation.standard: For multi-line match expressions, there should be a comma after the last arm.

code.title: Valid: Comma after the last arm.
Invalid: No comma after the last arm.
